title: 1-D fixed array traverse: sum, positive count, max; extent and endpoints

provenance.author: DRPLi E2E-50/P2 step 4 corpus
provenance.note: written for this project; independently specified; no third-party import

notes:
Fixed inputs include negatives, a zero and a duplicate (12 twice). Scalar
compares are variable-left, variable operands: the strict scalar relations are
backed by the byte-exact panel specimens probes/G114B.PLI (golden/e2e3b/G114B)
and artefacts/E35W5.PLI (golden/e35w). Shapes deliberately absent, all measured
refusals or divergences: array-element compares (AB11/LR9 pinned refusals),
>= / <= scalars (COND.GE_LE refused), literal-left (COND.LITERAL_LEFT refused),
k<=0 literal (corpus-compile measurement 2026-11-02: mine refuses
'compare > k<=0 form unproven [TBD]'), multidim, K_PLUS_X store, traversal
reload. Compile-checked at authoring against the current binary: 896-byte .REL
(code=358 data=30).
